title: DebugCrosshair
description: Adds customization to the Debug Crosshair.
body:
## DebugCrosshair
Adds customization to the Debug Crosshair. Along with backporting some modern QoL.

---

### Features
- Display Mode
- Crosshair Toggle
- Axis Width
- Axis Outline Width 
- Axis Toggles
- Axis Length
- Axis Color
- Axis Outline
- Axis Outline Color

---
